builder.root_cause: (P1) Phase 10 treated the OLD tree's per-file modes as operator decisions: it replayed the recorded baseline onto the release's freshly deployed files and gave only NEW files the directory's mode, then normalise_frontend_ownership re-owned the tree to root keeping modes. v1.0.x's online install.sh left lib/vue.global.prod.js at mktemp's 0600 (kept by rsync -a), servable only because www-data OWNED it; replayed under a root owner it became root:root 0600, unreadable by www-data, so Phase 12's effective-access check failed and the run rolled back. (P2) A restore point's ownership record for a manifest-less host came only from LEGACY_V11X_VERSIONS=(1.1.0 1.1.1); a 1.0.6 host (tags v1.0.6..v1.0.11 all report tm/VERSION 1.0.6) had none, so restore_owned_artefacts took its 'unknown release' branch: it retired nothing, listed every newer artefact as a problem (RESTORE INCOMPLETE), and returned before removing the newer release's INSTALL_MANIFEST. The next run's Phase 4 (backup_owned_artefacts) copied any INSTALL_MANIFEST on the host as the installed release's record without checking whose it was, so the 1.3.0 leftovers became '1.0.6's' and a later --restore kept them.
